hooks.command: file="$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH"; if [[ "$file" == *".env"* ]] && [[ "$file" != *".env.example"* ]]; then echo 'BLOCKED: Direct edits to .env files are not allowed. Modify .env.example instead and update your local .env manually.' && exit 1; fi

file="$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH"; if [[ "$file" == *"/prisma/migrations/"* ]] && [[ "$file" == *.sql ]]; then echo 'NOTE: editing an existing migration. Applied migrations must never be edited in place — Prisma checksums them and CI will fail. If this migration has already been applied anywhere, create a new one instead.'; fi

file="$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH"; case "$file" in *.ts|*.tsx|*.mjs) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; rel="${file#/Users/tejasnirala/learning/rcln/}"; case "$rel" in apps/*/*|packages/*/*) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; ws="$(printf '%s' "$rel" | cut -d/ -f1,2)"; sub="${rel#"$ws"/}"; docker compose -f /Users/tejasnirala/learning/rcln/docker-compose.yml exec -T -w "/app/$ws" api npx eslint "$sub" 2>/dev/null || true

file="$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH"; if [[ "$file" == *"packages/db/prisma/schema/"*.prisma ]]; then echo 'REMINDER: the Prisma schema changed. A new tenant table needs (1) organizationId + @@unique([organizationId, id]), (2) an entry in prisma/rls/enable-rls.sql, (3) that SQL appended to the generated migration, (4) pnpm db:rls:check, (5) a case in apps/api/tests/integration/tenant-isolation.test.ts. See .kb/Architecture/CONVENTIONS.md.'; fi

root="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-/Users/tejasnirala/learning/rcln}"; file="$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH"; case "$file" in *.ts|*.tsx|*.mts|*.cts|*.prisma) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; rel="${file#"$root"/}"; case "$rel" in apps/*|packages/*) touch "$root/.kb/.dirty" ;; esac; exit 0

root="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-/Users/tejasnirala/learning/rcln}"; [ -f "$root/.kb/.dirty" ] || exit 0; rm -f "$root/.kb/.dirty"; node "$root/.kb/generate.mjs" --quiet 2>&1 || echo 'WARNING: .kb regeneration failed — run pnpm kb'; exit 0
